about.about_description: We are revolutionizing Ethiopian agriculture through technology, connecting farmers directly with vendors for a more efficient and fair supply chain.
about.mission_text: To empower Ethiopian farmers and vendors by creating a direct, transparent, and efficient agricultural marketplace that eliminates middlemen and ensures fair prices for all stakeholders.
about.vision_text: To become Ethiopia's leading agri-tech platform, transforming the agricultural supply chain and contributing to food security and economic growth.
about.fair_trade_desc: Ensuring fair prices for farmers and affordable prices for vendors
about.efficiency_desc: Direct delivery model eliminates middlemen and reduces waste
about.transparency_desc: Complete visibility from farm to market with real-time tracking
about.community_desc: Building strong agricultural communities across Ethiopia
about.founder_desc: Software engineering student passionate about agri-tech solutions
about.cto_desc: Software engineering student curious about tech solutions
about.operations_desc: software engineering student with deep passion in tech ecosystem
about.story_content: Agar Agritech was founded in 2023 by a team of Ethiopian entrepreneurs and technologists who recognized the challenges facing the agricultural supply chain. We saw farmers struggling to get fair prices for their produce while vendors paid high prices for goods that passed through multiple middlemen. Our mission is to use technology to create a more efficient, transparent, and fair agricultural marketplace.
about.impact_content: Since our launch, we have facilitated over 50,000 transactions, connected 500+ farmers with 1,200+ vendors, and created economic opportunities across 10+ regions in Ethiopia. Our platform has helped farmers increase their income by an average of 30% while providing vendors with fresher produce at better prices.
about.future_content: We are expanding to cover all regions of Ethiopia, introducing new features like weather-based pricing, crop insurance, and financial services. Our goal is to become the leading agri-tech platform in East Africa, transforming how agricultural business is conducted.
about.cta_description: Be part of the movement transforming Ethiopian agriculture. Whether you're a farmer, vendor, or driver, we have a place for you.

how_it_works.benefits_by_role: Benefits of our platform to users
how_it_works.page_subtitle: AgriMart connects farmers, vendors, and drivers through a seamless digital platform that streamlines the agricultural supply chain.
how_it_works.process_description: A simple, efficient process that connects farmers directly with vendors through our digital platform.
how_it_works.farmers_list_desc: Farmers cooperatives list their fresh produce with prices and quantities on the platform.
how_it_works.vendors_browse_desc: Vendors browse available products, add to cart, and place orders with instant TeleBirr payment.
how_it_works.driver_assignment_desc: System assigns available truck drivers who pick up goods directly from farmers.
how_it_works.direct_delivery_desc: Drivers deliver goods directly to vendors with real-time tracking and status updates.
how_it_works.automatic_settlement_desc: Platform automatically calculates commissions and disburses payments to farmers and drivers.
how_it_works.faq1_question: How do farmers list their products?
how_it_works.faq1_answer: Farmers can easily create an account, verify their cooperative, and start listing products with photos, descriptions, prices, and available quantities through our user-friendly dashboard.
how_it_works.faq2_answer: We currently support TeleBirr for all payments. Vendors pay instantly through TeleBirr, and farmers receive their payments through automated settlements after successful delivery.
how_it_works.faq3_answer: Our system automatically assigns the nearest available driver based on location, capacity, and current workload. Both farmers and vendors can track the delivery in real-time.
how_it_works.faq4_answer: We charge a small service commission only on successful transactions. The exact percentage varies based on the product type and is transparently displayed before order confirmation.
how_it_works.faq5_question: How do I get started as a vendor?
how_it_works.faq5_answer: Simply create a vendor account, verify your business, and you can immediately start browsing products, placing orders, and making payments through our secure platform.
how_it_works.get_started_description: Join thousands of farmers, vendors, and drivers who are already using Agar Agritech to transform their agricultural business.

privacy.intro_paragraph: Welcome to our Agritech Platform. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and safeguard your information when you use our services.
privacy.introduction_content: This Privacy Policy applies to all information collected through our mobile application, website, and any related services (collectively, our 'Services'). By using our Services, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.
privacy.information_collection_content: We collect several types of information to provide and improve our Services to you.
privacy.collection_item1: Personal Identification Information: Your name, phone number, email address, and location.
privacy.collection_item2: Farm & Business Details: Information about your farm size, crops grown, livestock, and farming practices.
privacy.collection_item3: Transaction & Financial Data: Details of purchases, sales, and payments made through the platform, including Telebirr transaction IDs.
privacy.collection_item4: Technical & Usage Data: Your IP address, device type, app crashes, and the pages of our Service that you visit.
privacy.collection_item5: Location Data: With your permission, we may collect GPS data to provide localized weather, market prices, and advisory services.
privacy.collection_item6: Communication Data: Records of your correspondence with us, other farmers, or buyers on the platform.
privacy.how_we_use_content: We use the information we collect for various business purposes, including:
privacy.use_item1: To create and manage your user account.
privacy.use_item2: To facilitate transactions and connect you with buyers/sellers.
privacy.use_item3: To process your payments securely via Telebirr.
privacy.use_item4: To send you personalized agricultural advisories, weather alerts, and market price information.
privacy.use_item5: To provide customer support and respond to your inquiries.
privacy.use_item6: To analyze and improve the performance and features of our Services.
privacy.use_item7: To send you service-related messages and promotional communications (you can opt-out at any time).
privacy.information_sharing_content: We do not sell your personal data. We may share your information in the following situations:
privacy.sharing_item1: With Other Users: To facilitate a transaction, your contact and product details may be shared with a buyer or seller.
privacy.sharing_item2: With Service Providers: We share data with trusted third parties who assist our operations, such as cloud hosting, data analysis, and payment processing (including Telebirr).
privacy.sharing_item3: For Legal Reasons: If required by law, regulation, or legal process, we may disclose your information.
privacy.sharing_item4: To Protect Rights: To investigate potential violations of our terms or to protect the safety of our users and the public.
privacy.sharing_item5: With Your Consent: We may share your information for any other purpose with your explicit consent.
privacy.data_security_content: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures designed to protect your personal information. However, no electronic transmission over the internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.
privacy.data_retention_content: We will retain your personal information only for as long as is necessary for the purposes set out in this Privacy Policy, and to comply with our legal obligations.
privacy.your_rights_content: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.rights_item1: Access: The right to request copies of the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.rights_item2: Correction: The right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate.
privacy.rights_item3: Deletion: The right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
privacy.rights_item4: Objection: The right to object to our processing of your personal data.
privacy.rights_item5: Data Portability: The right to request that we transfer the data we have collected to another organization, or directly to you.
privacy.telebirr_integration_content: For payment processing, we integrate with Telebirr. When you make a transaction, you will be redirected to the Telebirr application. We do not store your Telebirr PIN or password. We only receive and store transaction confirmation details (e.g., transaction ID, amount, date) necessary to complete your order on our platform. Your use of Telebirr is also subject to Telebirr's own Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.
privacy.changes_content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the 'last updated' date.
privacy.contact_content: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: [Your Agritech Platform Support Email] or [Your Physical Address].
privacy.consent_content: By using our platform, you consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

terms.payments_content: All financial transactions conducted through the platform are facilitated via the integrated Telebirr payment gateway. You agree to comply with Telebirr's terms of service. The platform is not responsible for any errors, delays, or failures in the payment processing system. faq.page_subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about our platform.
faq.general_a1: Our platform is a digital marketplace that connects local farmers directly with vendors and buyers, integrating secure payments via Telebirr and logistics to streamline the agricultural supply chain.
faq.general_q2: How much does it cost to use the platform?
faq.general_a2: Creating an account and browsing listings is free. We charge a small service fee only on successful transactions. All fees are transparently displayed before you confirm any sale or purchase.
faq.general_q3: Is my data safe and private?
faq.general_a3: Yes. We protect your data in accordance with our comprehensive Privacy Policy. We never sell your personal information to third parties and only share essential details (like your contact info) with a buyer/seller to facilitate your transactions.
faq.general_q4: How do I delete my account?
faq.general_a4: You can request account deletion by contacting our support team. Please note that we are required to retain records of completed financial transactions for legal and accounting purposes, even after your account is closed.
faq.farmer_q1: How do I list my produce for sale?
faq.farmer_a1: Go to the 'My Products' section in the app, tap 'Sell New Product', and fill in the details like type, quality, price, quantity, and upload clear photos. Once submitted, it will be visible to all buyers on the platform.
faq.farmer_q2: How and when do I get paid?
faq.farmer_a2: Payment is securely processed through Telebirr. The funds are held in escrow by the platform and are released to your designated Telebirr account once the buyer confirms receipt of the goods in good condition.
faq.farmer_q3: What happens if a buyer complains about the quality?
faq.farmer_a3: We have a dispute resolution process. The buyer must provide evidence (e.g., photos). Our support team will mediate to find a fair solution, which could involve a partial refund or, in rare cases, a full return funded by the farmer.
faq.farmer_q4: How is the pickup/delivery of my products arranged?
faq.farmer_a4: You can choose to use our integrated logistics service with verified drivers or arrange your own transport. For platform logistics, you will be matched with a nearby driver who will handle pickup from your specified location.
faq.vendor_q1: How can I find specific agricultural products?
faq.vendor_a1: Use the search bar on the marketplace homepage. You can filter by product type, location, quality grade, and price to find exactly what you need from local farmers.
faq.vendor_q2: How do I ensure the quality of the products I'm buying?
faq.vendor_a2: We encourage you to check farmer ratings and reviews from previous transactions. You can also communicate directly with the farmer through our in-app chat to ask for more details or additional photos before purchasing.
faq.vendor_a3: We currently support secure payments exclusively through Telebirr integration. This ensures your money is protected until you confirm satisfactory delivery of your order.
faq.vendor_q4: What if the delivered goods are damaged or not as described?
faq.vendor_a4: Do not confirm receipt in the app. Immediately contact the farmer and our support team through the 'Report an Issue' feature in your order history. Provide clear photos as evidence to initiate the dispute resolution process.
faq.driver_q1: How do I get delivery jobs on the platform?
faq.driver_a1: Once your driver profile and documents are verified, you will receive notifications for available delivery requests in your area. You can accept or decline jobs based on your capacity and route.
faq.driver_q2: How and when will I receive my payment for a delivery?
faq.driver_a2: Delivery fees are paid upon successful completion of the job. Payment is processed through the platform and transferred to your linked Telebirr account, typically within 24-48 hours after the buyer confirms delivery.
faq.driver_q3: What should I do if there is a problem during delivery?
faq.driver_a3: Use the in-app emergency contact feature to immediately notify both the buyer/seller and our support team. Document the issue with photos and notes within the app to protect yourself and help resolve the situation fairly.
faq.driver_q4: What kind of vehicles and insurance are required?
faq.driver_a4: You must possess a valid driver's license, a registered vehicle in good condition suitable for cargo, and valid third-party liability insurance. Proof of these documents is required during the driver verification process.
faq.tech_q1: The app is crashing. What should I do?
faq.tech_a1: First, try closing and restarting the app. If the problem continues, check for updates in your phone's app store. If the issue persists, please contact our support team and specify your phone model and operating system.
faq.tech_q2: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
faq.tech_a2: On the login screen, tap 'Forgot Password?' and enter the phone number associated with your account. You will receive an SMS with a code to create a new password.
faq.tech_q3: I'm having trouble with the Telebirr payment. Who should I contact?
faq.tech_a3: For issues directly related to Telebirr (e.g., failed transaction, PIN reset), please contact Telebirr customer support. For issues with a transaction within our platform (e.g., payment not reflecting on an order), contact our support team.
faq.tech_q4: How do I update the app to the latest version?
faq.tech_a4: Updates are managed through the Google Play Store for Android devices and the App Store for iOS devices. You can enable automatic updates in your phone's settings or manually check for updates in the respective store.
